WITH fee_order_user AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    f.feerate,
    u.acctscope
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    AVG(feerate) as avg_fee_rate
  FROM fee_order_user
  WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY orderslink, acctscope
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) as overall_mean
  FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.orderslink,
    pa.acctscope,
    pa.avg_fee_rate,
    pa.avg_fee_rate - gm.overall_mean as excess
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
  WHERE pa.avg_fee_rate > gm.overall_mean
),
ranked_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    avg_fee_rate,
    excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC) as rank
  FROM filtered_pairs
)
SELECT 
  orderslink,
  acctscope,
  avg_fee_rate,
  excess,
  rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank;

assumptions.assumption: Multiple fees can reference the same orderslink. The average fee rate is computed across all fees for each unique (orderslink, acctscope) pair.
The 'mean of all the pair averages' refers to the arithmetic average (AVG) of avg_fee_rate across all (orderslink, acctscope) pairs that have non-NULL feerate values.
